contracts.order: Actual Cursed/reaction -> one percentage spin/commit/reaction -> chosen band canonical Cursed Power children/grants/reactions -> chosen band Cursed Weakness children/grants/reactions -> Backstory.
contracts.probability: Eleven percentages baseWeight1/1 per 11; a ten-point label step is not10% probability. Bands have ordinary masses3/11,3/11,3/11,2/11. Each canonical Power child20 equal5%; draft Weakness12 equal1/12. Apply authorized distribution policies after hard eligibility.
contracts.bands: Only selected band totals: 0–20 zero/zero;30–50 one/zero;60–80 two/one;90–100 three/two. Never stack earlier thresholds, add extra count spins or interpret percentage as a success roll.
contracts.power: Reuse power-cursed20 with existing canonical tier1–5 definitions/ratings. Not Demonic/Angelic/Divine, no private copy, tier floor, mastery guarantee, cursed-race dispatch or extra stat/weapon bonus.
contracts.weakness: Grant only selected source-owned weakness. These are additional to the later normal main Weakness result and persist alongside it. Conditional weaknesses impose their authored guard/effect only; no always-on main-stat reduction or automatic severity/activation/countermeasure wheel.
contracts.repeatedCalls: Each planned child is one independent actual invocation with unique step/ordinal and saved continuation. Keep the same eligible canonical pool between calls; duplicates do not trigger an unrequested exclusion/reroll or substituted reward. Record every actual source. Repeated weakness IDs do not infer doubled severity or numeric penalty; global duplicate-power handling remains the existing policy.
contracts.ownership: Early Cursed powers survive main Power None and use the one normal shared Power Mastery resolution. Main Power and Weakness stages still occur. Power Mastery opens no Enchant; numeric/mastery bonuses from other sources calculate at final phase.
contracts.recipeAuthority: Select one branchProfiles recipe; execute its steps once. Counts and display context describe that same recipe and never schedule a second copy.
contracts.ledger: Freeze percentage rule/pool/odds/result, selected band/ordered schedule, catalog versions, child IDs/results, canonical power tiers and source weakness guards. Branch key runId/sourceArchetypeInvocationId/sourcePercentageSpinId/eventProfileId; child grants keyed by actual invocation/definition. Replay/media retry resumes next unfinished step without redraw or duplicate grants.
contracts.reaction: Each actual percentage/power/weakness result gets its own stacked-context reaction. Future child results, main stats and mastery remain unknown; no implicit funny tag or extra Shrek hook from labels/fixed grants.
contracts.return: 0–20 returns after percentage reaction; other bands finish all scheduled children before Backstory. Preserve gate/global Size/race history and all prior owned rewards.
contracts.runtime: Core package thresholds/counts approved. Exact weakness roster/conditional scope is an authored editable draft; counter capability/severity/body-role fit and executor remain configuration. Final roster is not activated.
